name: ARMOR-NODE-SOLAR-HMI
role: Solar touch screen: shows the batteries and the inverters of the installation from ARMOR-SERVER on a 7-inch wall screen
stack: C++17 (host-tested core and simulator); the ESP-IDF firmware for an ESP32-P4 board with an ESP32-C6 radio is not written yet
deployment_target: Guition JC1060P470C (ESP32-P4 with ESP32-C6, 7-inch 1024 x 600 screen); no firmware yet and nothing has run on the board
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host
notes: What does not depend on the board is written and tested on a computer: the reading of the solar devices and totals that ARMOR-SERVER answers, the decisions behind the screen (old data means read-only, the levels of cells, modules and batteries, blinking never above twice a second), the PIN of the screen (kept as a salted, iterated hash, with locks and a short session), the check before an operation on a battery is offered (only checking it or resetting its counters), and a simulator of an installation whose readings follow the message schemas of ARMOR-COMMON. There is no firmware, no screen drawing and no connection to a server yet; nothing here sends an order to a battery; nothing has run on a board.
